claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright provides naval propulsion and auxiliary equipment (main coolant pumps, power-dense compact motors, generators, steam turbines, valves, secondary propulsion) primarily to the U.S. Navy, most notably supporting the Virginia-class submarine program.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: we provide naval propulsion and auxiliary equipment ... primarily to the U.S. Navy, most notably supporting the Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine programs, as well as the Ford-class aircraft carrier program.

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supports the Columbia-class submarine program with naval propulsion and auxiliary equipment.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: most notably supporting the Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine programs

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supplies the Ford-class aircraft carrier program and is recognizing significant production revenues on the Ford class aircraft carrier.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: we are recognizing significant production revenues on the Ford class aircraft carrier, Columbia class and Virginia class submarines, and numerous surface ship platforms

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright is recognizing development revenues on the future generation SSN(X) submarine program.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: as well as development revenues on the future generation SSN(X) submarine

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright expects to benefit in 2026 and beyond from Golden Dome funding, citing $113B of OBBBA funding anticipated to support FY2026 with key priorities including Golden Dome.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: Key priorities include naval shipbuilding ... and Golden Dome, all of which are anticipated to receive strong funding and provide numerous growth opportunities for Curtiss-Wright in 2026 and beyond.

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright provides electronic stabilization systems equipment supporting ground combat and tactical vehicles, and is well positioned in the international ground defense market, in support of vehicle modernization which is a stated FY2026 priority.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.object_value: Ground combat / tactical vehicle modernization (e.g., Stryker, Bradley, M1 Abrams)
claims.source_quote: We are also well positioned with our electronics stabilization systems equipment supporting ground combat and tactical vehicles ... vehicle modernization, tactical aircraft modernization, and Golden Dome

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright expects to benefit from increased aerospace defense funding for C5ISR, electronic warfare, encryption, unmanned systems, and communications programs.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: we expect to benefit from increased funding levels supporting the global market for manned and unmanned military aircraft, particularly Command, Control, Computers, Communications, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance ('C5ISR'), electronic warfare, encryption, unmanned systems, and communications programs.

claims.claim_text: Sales to the U.S. Government and foreign government end use represented 58% of total net sales in 2025 (vs 57% in 2024 and 56% in 2023).
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: Our sales to the U.S. Government and foreign government end use represented 58%, 57%, and 56% of total net sales during 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

claims.claim_text: Curtiss-Wright supplies Reactor Coolant Pumps (RCPs) and control rod drive mechanisms for commercial nuclear power plants, most notably to support the Generation III+ Westinghouse AP1000 reactor design, and is engaged on leading advanced Small Modular Reactor (SMR) designs.
claims.subject: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
claims.source_quote: we provide Reactor Coolant Pumps ('RCP's) and control rod drive mechanisms for commercial nuclear power plants, most notably to support the Generation III+ Westinghouse AP1000 reactor design. We are also actively engaged and pursuing business on the leading advanced Small Modular Reactor ('SMR') designs

claims.claim_text: The FY2026 Defense Appropriations Act was officially passed in February 2026 with base levels consistent with FY25, and OBBBA-approved $150B has $113B anticipated to support FY2026, potentially driving 13%+ topline defense-budget growth.
claims.subject: U.S. Department of War
claims.object_value: FY26 base consistent w/ FY25 + $113B OBBBA
claims.source_quote: The FY2026 Defense Appropriations Act was officially passed in February 2026, with base levels consistent with FY25 budget funding. In addition, the President's FY2026 Budget Request included $150 billion in overall funding approved by Congress under the OBBBA, $113 billion of which is anticipated to support FY2026.
